name: Garrett
source:
A young boy staying at the hospital with a broken leg he sustained in the war. Despite being such a young soldier, he's always cheerful and energetic, filled with boundless optimism. His dream is to be a hero some day, like his role model, Sir Biran.


(Taken from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/this-world-unknown/]website[/url])
